latest_release.body:
- Series colors follow Mermaid's palette theme variables: `pie1`–`pie8` in pie charts, `git0`–`git7` in git graphs, `cScale0`–`cScale7` in timelines, radar charts and treemaps, `cScale1`–`cScale8` in mindmaps, `venn1`–`venn8` in Venn diagrams, and the first eight colors of `xyChart.plotColorPalette` in XY charts. Shorter Venn and XY palettes repeat. Values that aren't colors keep the theme's color. #55 #98
- Labels on palette colors in pie charts, git graphs, timelines and treemaps use whichever of `--pele-fg-on-light` and `--pele-fg-on-dark` contrasts more.
- Edges that cross a subgraph's border bend less near the nodes they meet, and more edges come out straight. #97
- Unlinked nodes in a subgraph stay lined up when an edge from outside enters one of them, instead of that node dropping a rank.
- Block: labels in blocks that span several columns use the extra width to fit on fewer lines. #106 #107
- Quadrant: the `quadrantChart` settings `titleFontSize`, `quadrantLabelFontSize`, `xAxisLabelFontSize`, `yAxisLabelFontSize` and `pointLabelFontSize` set text sizes, as in Mermaid. Point labels wrap at the plot width instead of 200 pixels. #108 #109
